contrastive.explanation: Removing F1, F2 would drop the chain below the "≥2 confirmed abuse OR 1 abuse + 2 access" threshold, so the policy would escalate for human review.

risk.rationale: Confirmed account takeover chain: anomalous sign-ins from non-baseline ASNs (F2: AS-AEGEAN-EDU TR; F3: AS51167 Contabo DE, 15 events), followed by bulk SIS access (12 events in 60 min from 203.0.113.58, F1), and persistence via an API-created inbox forwarding rule to an external ProtonMail address (F5). All four supporting findings are CONFIRMED. The rejected VPN KEV claim is irrelevant to this account per the case notes. No data-quality conflicts. This meets the contain criteria (confirmed ATO chain), not merely monitor/benign, and does not require escalation since evidence is consistent and sufficient.
